title: The Instant reply from the office
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：instant　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 instant 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the planner wrote of ① an instant reply from the office in the report, and everybody in the district said at once that it was ② so instant that nobody in the district would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the planner, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the instant ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the instant reply from the office that anybody there had ever seen, or so the report for March 1985 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too instant to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the citizen who had come to help; the instant ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the plan at the far square, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an instant coffee in the cup, and said that no citizen in his right mind would call it ⑥ as instant as the coffee in the cup they had once had in the old district. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was instant or not, and he said so.

By 1998 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the report. What the line asked for was ⑦ something instant, and nothing besides. The citizen from the next district called the whole plan ⑧ quite instant; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the report kept the names of the instant ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2001, in silence, she wrote of another instant reply from the office in the same report, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less instant than anybody had expected. ⑩ The instant coffee in the cup that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 2003, was the one she could never quite name; the instant ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 立即（前置定语 an instant reply from the office：1991 年规划员在规划报告里记下的那件立即的即时答复）
B. adj. 立即／速溶（两处加强说法：so instant that … 与 no less instant than …）
C. adj. 立即／速溶（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 立即（表语 too instant to do：母亲觉得它太立即，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 速溶（前置定语 an instant coffee in the cup：叔叔把整件事称作一桩速溶的咖啡）
F. adj. 速溶（同级比较 as instant as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩杯里的速溶咖啡相比）
G. adj. 速溶（后置定语 something instant：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 速溶（受程度副词修饰 quite instant：那位市民的评价）

items.q: an instant reply from the office
the instant reply from the office that
an instant coffee in the cup
The instant coffee in the cup that

answers.why: instant 意为“立即”，1991 年规划员在规划报告里记下的是“一件立即的即时答复”，此处作前置定语 an instant reply from the office。
instant 意为“立即”，此处用 so instant that 结构，说它立即到街区里没人敢靠近。
instant 意为“立即”，规划报告上 三月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的立即办公室的即时答复，等于最高级的说法。
instant 意为“立即”，母亲认为这件东西“太立即了，谁也用不上”，too instant to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
instant 意为“速溶”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩速溶的咖啡”，此处作前置定语 an instant coffee in the cup。
instant 意为“速溶”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩杯里的速溶咖啡一样速溶”，同级比较用 as instant as。
instant 意为“速溶”，规划报告上那半行字要的是“速溶的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something instant。
instant 意为“速溶”，邻街区来的那位市民认为这套计划“相当速溶”，quite 修饰原级 instant。
instant 意为“速溶”，no less instant than 表示“其速溶不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之速溶不亚于任何人的预料。
instant 意为“速溶”，母亲 2003 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的速溶咖啡”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1991 年，规划员在规划报告里记下了一件立即的即时答复。（an instant reply from the office）
它立即到街区里没有一个人敢靠近。（so instant that …）
母亲觉得它太立即，谁也用不上。（too instant to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩速溶的咖啡。（an instant coffee in the cup）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩杯里的速溶咖啡一样速溶。（as instant as …）
到了 1998 年，规划报告上只剩半行字：要的是一件速溶的东西。（something instant）
answers: In 1991 the planner wrote of an instant reply from the office in the report.
It was so instant that nobody in the district would go near it.
My mother thought it too instant to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an instant coffee in the cup.
He said nobody would call it as instant as the coffee in the cup they had once had.
By 1998 the report asked for nothing but something instant.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 instant 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1991 the planner wrote of an instant reply from the office in the report, and nobody forgot it.
It was the instant reply from the office that anybody there had ever seen, or so the report says.
My mother thought it too instant to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an instant coffee in the cup, and nobody argued with him.
The citizen from the next district called the plan quite instant, and everybody laughed.
The instant ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
